description.value:
You have an inexplicable knack for beating the odds. You have a number of luck points equal to your proficiency bonus. Whenever you make an attack roll, an ability check, or a saving throw, you can spend one luck point to roll an additional d20 and choose which of the d20s to use.

You can also spend a luck point when a creature makes an attack roll against you, rolling a d20 and choosing whether the attack uses the attacker's roll or yours. You regain all spent luck points when you finish a long rest.
